# Image

The Docker images of the host. `osapi behavior get --name image` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

|             |                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                              |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                              |
| Description | List the images of the host                                                                                                       |

| Command     | [osapi client node container image list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/image/list.md)                                  |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                         |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                          |

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

## Method pull

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | pull                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Pull an image                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Detail      | Runs docker pull, and answers the ID and the size of the image that the host has after it. A pull that gets nothing new, because the host had the image of that reference already, reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/image/pull                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permission  | container:execute                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node container image pull](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/image/pull.md)                                                                                                           |
| Input type  | PullInput                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Output type | PullResult                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                               | DESCRIPTION                    |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| image | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9._/:@-]*$ | The image, such as alpine:3.20 |

### Output (4)

| FIELD    | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                          |
| -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| image    | string  | The image                                                            |
| image_id | string  | The ID of the image that the host has now                            |
| size     | integer | Its size in bytes                                                    |
| changed  | boolean | Whether the pull got a new image: false when the host had it already |

### Examples (1)

| EXAMPLE       | INPUT             | OUTPUT                                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Pull an image | image=alpine:3.20 | image=alpine:3.20, image_id=sha256:91ef0af61f39ece4d6710e465df5ed6ca12112358344fd51ae6a3b886634148b, size=3.634816e+06, changed=true |

## Method delete

|             |                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | delete                                                                                                                                                 |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                  |
| Description | Remove an image                                                                                                                                        |
| Detail      | Runs docker rmi, with -f when force is set, which removes an image that a container uses. An image that the host does not have reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | DELETE                                                                                                                                                 |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/container/image/&#123;image&#125;                                                                                       |
| Permission  | container:write                                                                                                                                        |
| Command     | [osapi client node container image delete](../../../usage/cli/client/node/container/image/delete.md)                                                   |
| Input type  | DeleteInput                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                 |

### Input (2)

| FIELD | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                               | DESCRIPTION                             |
| ----- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| image | string  | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9._/:@-]*$ | The image, by its reference or its ID   |
| force | boolean | no       |                                           | Remove it also when a container uses it |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| image   | string  | The image                |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                              | INPUT             | OUTPUT                           |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Remove an image                      | image=alpine:3.20 | image=alpine:3.20, changed=true  |
| An image that the host does not have | image=alpine:3.20 | image=alpine:3.20, changed=false |
